description: Crittenden Wines participates in the King's Birthday Winter Wine Weekend with special cellar door events at both the Red Hill Showgrounds (Winter Wine Festival) and Crittenden winery in Dromana. Activities include in-depth seated tastings of 25+ wine styles; new restaurant (opened Oct 2025); and Lakeside Villa packages. Crittenden also offers a winter truffle escape package with Flinders Truffles (2-night stay + truffle hunt).
priceRange: AUD 30+ for tastings; restaurant from approx AUD 80–120pp
accessibilityNotes: Award-winning Wine Centre accessible; restaurant ground floor; Lakeside Villas — check with venue
weatherDependency: Outdoor alfresco gardens; indoor cellar door available
nearbyAttractions: Pt Leo Estate (nearby); Bass & Flinders Distillery; Peninsula Hot Springs
suggestedItineraryPairing: Arrive for cellar door tasting; stay at Lakeside Villas; dine in restaurant; include hot springs next morning
internalNotes: Crittenden also present at Winter Wine Festival (Red Hill Showgrounds) on Sat 6 June. Truffle escape package with Flinders Truffles (2-night stay + hunt) available — contact Crittenden for pricing.
